model.name: hstu-illustrative-10b
model.calibration_note: Illustrative 2P linear FLOPs for 10B active parameters; KV/attention assume 40 layers x 6144 KV width in BF16. The manuscript does not specify these dimensions. Replace with measured HSTU coefficients before claiming quantitative reproduction.

metadata.capacity_derivation: 8 x 36 GB HBM minus illustrative BF16 weights; decimal GB. Optional 2 TB CPU pool, PCIe 6.0 at 128 GB/s. CPU sustained bandwidth is assumed link-saturating, not measured. HBM-only/CPU variants additionally reserve 36 GB HBM for active KV.
metadata.scope: One ASTRA NPU; FCFS requests, chunked prefill, per-layer projection/attention/output DAGs. Explicit weight/KV traffic. Whole-user cache capacities exclude weights and a 36 GB active KV workspace. Coefficients and projection split require calibration; activations and kernel launch overhead are not modeled.
